items.title: NextEra Energy (NEE) Stock Looks Fairly Valued On Merger Probe Closure
items.summary: NextEra Energy has delivered a 57.7% share price return over the past three years, helped by a growing renewables footprint and a steady utility base. That puts fresh focus on whether the current price still lines up with what its dividend stream can justify. With investors weighing merger headlines and a large capital spending program, the question now is how much of that future income is already reflected in the stock at around US$84.58. items.title: 3 defensive stocks to watch as tech, chip volatility persists
items.summary: Investing.com -- The tech rout has pushed money into defensive sectors. Hedge funds lost more than 3% in the week ended Nov 20, their worst week since April 2025, and the Nasdaq Composite fell 10% that week. JPMorgan said healthcare has drawn large inflows and staples positioning is at historical highs (Read more, Nov 23, 2026).
